messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: New features in development version of Shiny
parts:
Hi everyone -

We've recently added some new features to the development version of Shiny. If you're feeling adventurous (or if you like finding bugs), you can install the latest version with:
  install.packages('httpuv')
  install.packages('devtools')  # Install devtools if needed
  devtools::install_github('shiny', 'rstudio')


The new features include:

* A new reactive values object named clientData, which carries information about the client browser and can be accessed inside the shinyServer function. The information includes the hidden status of output objects, height/width plot output objects, and the URL of the browser.

* A new function `renderImage()`, which lets you send any image files to the client, not just ones generated by R's normal graphical device system.

* Support for high-resolution (Retina) displays. Plots generated by renderPlot() will automatically be created at higher resolution if the client is using a high-res display.

* Support for the new httpuv package, which makes file uploading work properly with Shiny server.

* A new method for detecting hidden output objects. Instead of checking that height and width are 0, it checks that the object or any ancestor in the DOM  has style display:none.

We also have some pages in the tutorial that explain how to use these new features. Until the new version is officially released, these pages will only be in tutorial page from my repository here:
  http://wch.github.com/shiny/tutorial/#client-data
  http://wch.github.com/shiny/tutorial/#sending-images


Enjoy!
-Winston

Hi everyone -

We've recently added some new features to the development version of Shiny. If you're feeling adventurous (or if you like finding bugs), you can install the latest version with:
  install.packages('httpuv')
  install.packages('devtools')  # Install devtools if needed
  devtools::install_github('shiny', 'rstudio')


The new features include:

* A new reactive values object named clientData, which carries information about the client browser and can be accessed inside the shinyServer function. The information includes the hidden status of output objects, height/width plot output objects, and the URL of the browser.

* A new function `renderImage()`, which lets you send any image files to the client, not just ones generated by R's normal graphical device system.

* Support for high-resolution (Retina) displays. Plots generated by renderPlot() will automatically be created at higher resolution if the client is using a high-res display.

* Support for the new httpuv package, which makes file uploading work properly with Shiny server.

* A new method for detecting hidden output objects. Instead of checking that height and width are 0, it checks that the object or any ancestor in the DOM  has style display:none.

We also have some pages in the tutorial that explain how to use these new features. Until the new version is officially released, these pages will only be in tutorial page from my repository here:
  http://wch.github.com/shiny/tutorial/#client-data
  http://wch.github.com/shiny/tutorial/#sending-images


Enjoy!
